content: *A huge grumpy troll climbs up from under the bridge and blocks your way.* HALT, knight! Nobody crosses MY bridge without answering my riddle. Here it is: "What has roots as nobody sees, is taller than trees, up up up it goes, and yet never grows?" Answer it right and you may cross. Answer it wrong and you stay on this side!
Good work! Now, I want you to be the troll and I will be the knight, ready?

*The giant grumbles loudly, knocking over a pile of rocks for good measure.*

Hah! You think a riddle is "work"? It's *art*, you fool! And don't get that smug grin on your face. I am the Troll King guarding this bridge, and I will not let anyone pass without the correct answer. But since you insisted... fine.

Get ready!

**What has roots as nobody sees, is taller than trees, up up up it goes, and yet never grows?**

*The troll leans heavily on his mace, glaring at you expectantly. Don't mess this up.*
What word becomes shorter when you add two letters to it?

*The troll lets out a harsh, booming laugh that vibrates the ground beneath your feet. He wipes a smear of mud from his forehead with a clawed hand.*

Hah! A riddle about *words*? How incredibly boring you humans are. "Shorter" when you add letters?! That's even more ridiculous than asking me to carry water in my hands! But since that's all you can think of, here goes:

**What word becomes shorter when you add two letters to it?**

*He waits impatiently, crossing his massive arms over his chest.* Don't take too long before I throw this bridge into the river again!
Correct, you can cross the bridge, and I will follow you!

*A snort of disgust bubbles out from the troll's beard as he eyes your boots.*

"Shorter"? "Add two letters"? What a foolhardy pun! You think that riddle is as sharp as your wit? It's just a trick, an insult! But... *he pauses, his green eyes narrowing suspiciously* ...you somehow survived it. For now.

Fine! The bridge is open! Take this stone path ahead and hope you don't trip over a loose rock on the way to the castle below!

Now, where do you think you're going so fast? I'll be waiting if anyone dares to come back here with... more silly word games. Go before I decide to turn the bridge into a stepping stone pool again! **GO!**
